{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "2-D design-domain outline and aspect ratio",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. II.1 names a 2-D cantilever, and Fig. 1(a)'s caption names a Design Domain, but the text supplies no outline or aspect ratio. Below, L denotes span and H denotes in-plane height.",
      "readings": [
        "Rectangular domain with L/H = 1",
        "Rectangular domain with L/H = 2",
        "Rectangular domain with L/H = 3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Overall physical size and length units",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. II.1 and the Fig. 1 caption give no absolute dimensions or length units. Geometrically similar rescaling preserves layout when thickness and filter lengths scale with the domain.",
      "readings": [
        "H = 1 mm, with all other lengths scaled proportionally",
        "H = 100 mm, with all other lengths scaled proportionally",
        "H = 1 m, with all other lengths scaled proportionally"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Uniform out-of-plane thickness or reporting depth",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The 2-D example specifies neither thickness nor a unit-depth convention. For fixed resultant forces, changing uniform thickness scales stiffness uniformly.",
      "readings": [
        "Unit thickness in the chosen length units",
        "Uniform thickness t = H/100",
        "Uniform thickness t = H/10"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Set of fixed nodes",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. II.1 mentions fixed nodes, and Fig. 1(a)'s caption labels Fixed Nodes, but neither gives their coordinates, number, or extent. Taking x = 0 as the supported end, the following sets all retain fixed translations.",
      "readings": [
        "Fix both translations at every node on x = 0",
        "Fix both translations only at (0,0) and (0,H)",
        "Fix both translations on the lower and upper quarters of x = 0"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Locations of load-bearing nodes",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. II.1 and Fig. 1(a)'s caption identify load-bearing nodes or Applied Forces without coordinates. Taking the free end as x = L, the transverse position remains unspecified.",
      "readings": [
        "Load at (L,0)",
        "Load at (L,H/2)",
        "Load at (L,H)"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial footprint and distribution of an applied force",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "The Fig. 1 caption does not identify the loaded node set, loaded length, or nodal distribution. Mentioning load-bearing nodes does not distinguish concentrated loading from discretized traction.",
      "readings": [
        "Entire resultant applied to one node",
        "Same resultant shared equally between two adjacent boundary nodes",
        "Same resultant distributed uniformly over the full free-end edge"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_direction",
      "entity": "Applied-force direction",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Neither Sec. II.1 nor the Fig. 1 caption states a force vector or angle; any direction indicated by the unavailable illustration cannot be recovered.",
      "readings": [
        "Transverse force (0,-F)",
        "Axial force (F,0)",
        "Oblique force (F/sqrt(2),-F/sqrt(2))"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Overall applied-force scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No force magnitude or force units are supplied for the 2-D example. Uniformly scaling all prescribed forces, with relative loading unchanged, scales linear-elastic compliance quadratically.",
      "readings": [
        "Overall resultant magnitude F = 1 in consistent force units",
        "Overall resultant magnitude F = 10 in the same units",
        "Overall resultant magnitude F = 100 in the same units"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Number of forces, relative loading, and load-case combination",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Fig. 1(a)'s generic Applied Forces wording and the references to load-bearing nodes do not specify force count, relative amplitudes, or simultaneous versus separate load cases. Sec. IV.1 supplies no load-case aggregation rule.",
      "readings": [
        "One force in one static load case",
        "Two equal forces at distinct nodes acting simultaneously",
        "Two forces applied separately, minimizing C1 + C2",
        "Two forces applied separately, minimizing 4*C1 + C2"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Prescribed solid or void cells near attachments",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. II.1 and the Fig. 1 caption do not identify any prescribed-density regions or explicitly state that none exist. Fixed displacement nodes do not themselves prescribe neighboring material densities.",
      "readings": [
        "No passive cells; all domain cells are designable",
        "A one-cell-thick passive solid strip adjoining the fixed boundary",
        "Passive solid cells adjoining the load-bearing nodes",
        "Passive solid attachment cells at both supports and loads"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Overall solid stiffness scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. IV.1 invokes a stiffness equation but gives no Young's modulus or equivalent stiffness scale. Scaling the entire constitutive tensor, including any proportional void stiffness, preserves layout.",
      "readings": [
        "Isotropic solid with E = 1 in consistent stress units",
        "Same constitutive ratios with E = 10",
        "Same constitutive ratios with E = 100"
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Poisson's ratio for an isotropic solid",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No Poisson's ratio is supplied in Sec. II.1, Sec. IV.1, or the appendices.",
      "readings": [
        "nu = 0.2",
        "nu = 0.3",
        "nu = 0.45"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Constitutive symmetry and material orientation",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The text gives no constitutive tensor and does not explicitly establish isotropy. A single linear-elastic material can also be orthotropic.",
      "readings": [
        "Homogeneous isotropic solid",
        "Homogeneous orthotropic solid with its stiffer principal direction along the span",
        "The same orthotropic solid with its stiffer principal direction across the span"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "2-D elasticity reduction",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Calling the example 2-D does not specify whether its stiffness matrix uses plane stress or plane strain.",
      "readings": [
        "Plane stress",
        "Plane strain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Density-to-stiffness interpolation and penalization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Fig. 1's caption says higher density reduces compliance, but neither it nor Sec. IV.1 defines the interpolation law or penalization exponent.",
      "readings": [
        "Linear interpolation: E(x) = Emin + (Es-Emin)*x",
        "SIMP interpolation with exponent p = 3",
        "SIMP interpolation with exponent p = 4",
        "RAMP interpolation: E(x) = Emin + (Es-Emin)*x/(1+3*(1-x))"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Numerical stiffness of void cells",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Although zero density is described as void, the text does not specify numerical residual stiffness or how singular stiffness matrices are handled.",
      "readings": [
        "Emin = 0 with explicit handling of disconnected or unstiffened degrees of freedom",
        "Emin/Es = 1e-9",
        "Emin/Es = 1e-3"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density-filter operator",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Appendix C explicitly establishes use of a density filter but gives no equation or kernel.",
      "readings": [
        "Normalized distance-weighted kernel with weights max(0,r-d)",
        "Uniform averaging within a circular neighborhood",
        "Helmholtz PDE density filter"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density-filter radius or length scale",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Appendix C gives no filter radius, physical length scale, or value relative to the mesh. Here h denotes a square-cell width.",
      "readings": [
        "Filter radius or characteristic length 1.5*h",
        "Filter radius or characteristic length 2*h",
        "Filter radius or characteristic length 3*h"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density-filter treatment at domain boundaries",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Appendix C and Fig. A3's caption discuss interaction between filtering and boundaries without specifying the boundary rule.",
      "readings": [
        "Truncate the averaging neighborhood and renormalize using only in-domain weights",
        "Extend density by zero outside the domain and retain full-neighborhood normalization",
        "Reflect density across domain boundaries before filtering"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Density fields used for stiffness and volume",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Secs. IV.1 and IV.3 use a single density symbol x, while Appendix C introduces a density filter without distinguishing design variables from filtered physical densities.",
      "readings": [
        "Evaluate both stiffness and the prescribed volume using filtered densities",
        "Evaluate stiffness using filtered densities but impose the volume constraint on unfiltered design variables"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Projection following density filtering",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Appendix C does not state whether filtered densities enter the material law directly or pass through a projection, and gives no projection parameters.",
      "readings": [
        "No projection after density filtering",
        "Smooth Heaviside projection with threshold eta = 0.5 and sharpness beta = 1",
        "Smooth Heaviside projection with threshold eta = 0.5 and sharpness beta = 8"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Structured-grid resolution",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No element counts, cell dimensions, or mesh-refinement level are reported for the 2-D example in Sec. II.1 or its captions.",
      "readings": [
        "60 by 20 elements",
        "120 by 40 elements",
        "240 by 80 elements"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Finite-element interpolation and quadrature",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. IV.1 mentions finite elements but gives no element order, integration rule, or stabilization for this example.",
      "readings": [
        "Bilinear four-node quadrilaterals with 2 by 2 Gauss integration",
        "Four-node quadrilaterals with one-point integration and hourglass stabilization",
        "Quadratic nine-node quadrilaterals with 3 by 3 Gauss integration"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization update rule and move limit",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. IV.1 mentions gradient-based algorithms, and Fig. 3(a) refers to implementation [17], but the supplied text gives no optimizer or update parameters.",
      "readings": [
        "Optimality-criteria updates with density move limit 0.2",
        "Optimality-criteria updates with density move limit 0.1",
        "MMA updates with density move limit 0.2"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Continuation of interpolation or projection parameters",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The text supplies no continuation schedule for penalization or projection. Different schedules can reach different local minima.",
      "readings": [
        "Hold the selected penalization and projection parameters fixed throughout",
        "Use SIMP p = 1 for 50 iterations, then p = 3",
        "With projection enabled, use beta = 1 for 50 iterations, then beta = 8"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The text does not supply an initial design for a conventional minimum-compliance optimization run.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform initial density x_e = 0.5",
        "Initial density 0.6 in the upper half and 0.4 in the lower half of an equal-area rectangular domain"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization termination",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "No convergence criterion, tolerance, or iteration limit is provided for the conventional optimized design.",
      "readings": [
        "Stop at maximum density change below 0.01, with a 200-iteration limit",
        "Stop at maximum density change below 0.001, with a 1000-iteration limit",
        "Stop at relative compliance change below 1e-6, with a 1000-iteration limit"
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Accuracy of stiffness-equation solves",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. IV.1 requires solving the stiffness equation but gives no algebraic solver or residual tolerance; the resulting effect depends on numerical conditioning and convergence.",
      "readings": [
        "Direct factorization to numerical precision",
        "Iterative solve with relative residual tolerance 1e-6",
        "Iterative solve with relative residual tolerance 1e-10"
      ],
      "effect": "unsure"
    }
  ]
}
